mode_inference_decision.rationale: This is a bounded CPU study of anatomically plausible elbow pivots, source-derived lateral axes and partial elbow-plate following. It leaves the frozen original geometry unchanged.

sweep_contract.motion: Forearm rigid rotation about one source-derived hinge pivot and axis, then rigid distal-axis roll; elbow plate rigidly follows at its selected fraction. No free translation or vertex deformation.
sweep_contract.collision_gate: Strict noncoplanar interior triangle crossing counts separate surface/surface from cap/surface and cap/cap. A possible surface channel requires zero surface/surface intersections at every sampled pose, no new upper/elbow exterior crossing and armor edge-length error below 1e-6 m. Cap collisions remain a publication blocker.

candidate_policy: Keep at most one selected editable Blend/GLB and pose set only if a complete surface channel exists. GPU rendering waits until grip_fit releases the GPU. A negative result freezes this bounded sweep without a larger search or geometry cuts.
